compares: Persons by type (student, faculty, staff, alumnus, guest) against the source after declared exclusions
Every source person has exactly one Semester person; none without a source; no two people merged
Legal name, preferred name, status code and privacy flags after the code table, including FERPA-style directory suppression
Every role and group membership lands on a real person and a real group, and the right one
Role and status timelines keep their overlaps and gaps (a person who was student then staff is not both, and not neither)
Former names and emails keep their original dates so old records still resolve to the person
Effective roles after group mapping equal the source's; no person gains administrator or advisor reach
A sample of real sign-ins (SSO assertion in, person out) resolves to the same person the legacy system resolved
Course results by term against the source
Each (person, term, course, section) result exists once
Grade, grade points, credits attempted/earned and repeat flags after the grade-scale table; "W", "I", "P" are not collapsed
Each result points at the section and term it was earned in, not just any section of that course
Grade change history keeps original dates, approvers and reasons; nothing says "changed by migration"
Program changes keep their effective dates with no new overlap or gap
Who may read or change a transcript: student, advisor, registrar staff, faculty of record; no widening
Term and cumulative GPA recomputed in Semester from migrated results equals the registrar's figure for every student
Remaining requirements and degree-eligibility recomputed equal the legacy audit for a stratified sample plus every graduating student
Catalog entries and sections by term
No section lost or duplicated, including cross-listed and combined sections
Credit hours, meeting days/times in the campus time zone, delivery mode, capacity and waitlist size
Prerequisites point at courses that exist in the right catalog year; instructors are real people with that role
Past catalog versions retained so old audits still resolve
Rule effective-date ranges keep their shape
Who may edit a section, set capacity or override a prerequisite
Seats taken and open per section equal the source at the same instant
Items by type per course
Every item in scope exists once; files are matched by content digest, not name
Points, weighting, due and availability dates (with zone), attempt limits, time limits, accommodations extensions
Items sit in the right module and course; embedded links and file references resolve; grade columns point at their assessments
Submissions keep original timestamps, attempt order and feedback authorship (late/on-time must survive)
Draft vs published, section restrictions, per-student releases, instructor/TA/auditor roles; no unpublished item visible, no grade visible early
Course total recomputed from migrated gradebook entries and weights equals the source's final grade for every student in sampled courses
A sampled item renders with the same content hash of its visible text, and media plays (accessibility alternatives retained)
Enrollments by term and status
One enrollment per person per section; no student enrolled twice or lost
Status (enrolled, waitlisted, withdrawn, audit), grade mode, credits and add/drop dates after code table
Each enrollment references a real person and the right section in the right term
Add/drop/withdraw events keep their dates (they decide tuition refunds and "W" vs "drop")
Holds keep their start/end so a released hold is not re-imposed and an active one is not lost
Who may register in which window; overrides and permission numbers
Credit load per student and enrolment per section equal the source; no section over capacity that was not
Transactions by type and period
Each ledger transaction once; a re-run never doubles a charge
Amount in integer minor units, sign (charge vs credit), currency, detail code, posting vs effective date
Every transaction lands on the right account and term; refunds point at the payment they reverse
Ledger order and original posting dates and actors preserved; adjustments are not collapsed into balances
Payment plan installments and aid disbursements keep their date structure
Who may see an account: the student, authorised payers, bursar staff; no guardian access that was not granted
Balance per account recomputed from the migrated ledger equals the bursar's, exactly (tolerance zero)
Control totals per fund and period tie to the general ledger; aid disbursed equals aid awarded less cancellations
Relationships by type
Each (student, related person, type) once; a guardian shared by siblings is one person
Consent scope, start and expiry, revocation, and whether the release was given by the student or an authorised proxy
Every relationship joins two real people, in the right direction
Consent grants and revocations keep original time and actor; a revocation is never dropped
Release windows keep their shape; none silently extended or left open-ended
For every guardian: the set of things visible equals the consented set. Widening is a stop-the-line failure
For sampled guardians (and every one with a revoked or expired release) the rendered view equals the permitted view
Records by service
No booking, assignment or request lost or duplicated
Dates and times in campus zone, room/bed identifiers, plan codes, status
Assignments reference real rooms and people; appointments reference real advisors
Advising notes and request threads keep authorship and dates
Housing and plan effective dates keep their shape
Advising, counselling-adjacent, disability and conduct records visible only to the roles that could see them; no widening to general staff
Occupancy per building, dining balances and event headcount equal the source
Applications, postings and credentials by type
Each application once; employers matched across spelling and merger
Application stage, offer status, dates, outcome codes
Applications reference live postings, postings reference employers
Stage history of each application keeps original dates
Credential issue/expiry ranges keep their shape
What each employer or recruiter can see equals what the student shared; nothing shared by default
Each credential still verifies against its issuer after migration; placement figures recompute to the published ones
Documents by type
Each source file's SHA-256 appears exactly once on the target; none missing, none substituted
Document type, effective date, language, and media type after code table; no filename-as-identity
Each document is attached to the right person or record; no document on a different student
Signatures and approvals keep signer, time and the digest they covered
Retention start, schedule and legal-hold intervals keep their shape; a hold is never lost
Who can open each document class equals the source's
A sample of documents opens and its digest equals the source's; a destruction run computes the same due set as the legacy schedule
